rules.rationale: Source: long SMILES reduced solubility (-11.46); longer molecules pack more polar groups, raising desolvation cost.
Source: mid-length SMILES raised solubility (+6.89); moderate size balances polar surface area and hydrophobic core.
Ring topology transferred (0.76 weight); rigid ring systems reduce conformational entropy and solvation.
Low ring content implies flexible chains, which solvate more easily than rigid ring scaffolds.

skills.hypothesis: Transfers ESOL length and ring effects to lipophilicity: compact, low-ring scaffolds should score highest. Fails if lipophilicity tracks halogenation or aromaticity rather than polarity.

rules.rationale: Counter-hypothesis: heteroatom-rich molecules carry polar functionality that lowers lipophilicity, reversing the weak hbond donor transfer.
Halogen-free molecules lack apolar substituents, so their polar surface dominates partitioning into octanol.
Aromatic pi systems are apolar and raise octanol-water partition coefficients, the direct lipophilicity measure.

fixed_initial.lesson: The source ESOL evidence is weak (confidences 0.16-0.41) and its length and ring effects are poorly supported (2-4 observations), so transferring them directly risks misguidance.
fixed_initial.revision_summary: Kept the source-grounded skill but lowered its confidence and semantic mass decay, and added a counter-hypothesis skill that reverses the uncertain heteroatom transfer and instead scores by polar surface area. Deployed the counter-hypothesis skill because polarity is the dominant driver of octanol-water partitioning, the lipophilicity measure.

true_feedback.lesson: Across four development seeds, the polarity-surface-area skill outscored the ring-topology skill (mean AUC 89.3 vs 85.3, mean final best 93.7 vs 85.3), but seed-level performance was mixed (one seed led, one lagged for each skill), so no single seed's outcome can be taken as causal.
true_feedback.revision_summary: Kept the deployed polarity-surface-area skill but replaced the halogen-free penalty with a halogen-rich bonus, since halogenation adds apolar substituents and raises hydrophobic surface. The ring-topology counter-hypothesis was retained unchanged. Deployed the polarity-surface-area skill because polarity is the dominant driver of octanol-water partitioning, the lipophilicity measure, and the halogen sign reversal makes it mechanistically consistent.
